answer: Listen for echoes: one operator driving a thousand fakes cannot stop the puppets moving in lockstep — the same clicks, the same pauses, the same replies, like a copper bell struck once and ringing a thousand times. The network records each identity's timing and action fingerprint, then clusters accounts whose behaviour echoes too closely and pays the whole cluster as one voice. A glacier-slow drift apart is not enough: only independent work breaks the pattern. To fake a crowd, the attacker must choreograph a thousand different lives, which costs more than any reward the fakes could earn.
